versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "personal-video-dl" v1.0.0.
- Multi-platform video downloading tool based on yt-dlp.
- Supports downloading from YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, TikTok, and many more sites.
- Features include automatic platform detection, format selection (audio/video), subtitle support, playlist and batch downloads.
- Offers both command-line usage and trigger phrases for easy operation.
